notes:
Thank you for reviewing bookshelv. The app follows the device language (German or English).

WHAT IT IS
A personal library and reading tracker: add books by scanning the ISBN barcode or by search, track reading progress, rate books, keep reading lists and remember who borrowed which book. Free, no ads, no tracking. Optional tips via in-app purchase (consumable, unlocks nothing).

HOW TO REVIEW (no account needed)
1. On first launch tap "Ohne Konto loslegen" / "Start without an account", then "Bibliothek anlegen" / "Create library". The library is stored only on the device.
2. Add a book: the barcode tab opens the camera scanner (VisionKit). Without a book at hand, switch to "Suchen" / "Search" and type e.g. "Juli Zeh", then tap a result.
3. Open a book to set the reading status, rate it, add it to a list or lend it to someone ("Verleihen" / "Lend").
4. Tips (consumable in-app purchases, unlock nothing): tap the person icon at the right of the bottom tab bar, then "bookshelv unterstützen" / "Support bookshelv" (heart). Also under Settings > "bookshelv unterstützen" / "Support bookshelv".
5. Settings > App: iCloud backup, backup to a file, connect an account, switch instance.

OPTIONAL ACCOUNT
Accounts live on a bookshelv server ("instance"); the default is https://bookshelv.aize-it.de (operated by the developer, registration is open, only a username and password are needed, no email). To try it: Settings > App > "Instanz wechseln" / "Switch instance" > "Bei einer Instanz anmelden" / "Sign in to an instance" > Continue > "Neues Konto" / "New account". Accounts can be deleted in the app: Settings > Account > "Konto löschen" / "Delete account".

NOT A WEB WRAPPER
The complete bookshelv server (Node.js runtime, SQLite database, catalog lookups) is bundled and runs on the device, so the app works fully offline and without any account. Native features: VisionKit barcode scanner incl. bulk scanning, iCloud Drive backup and restore, opening export files from other reading apps ("Open in bookshelv" for CSV), share sheet for exports and images, haptics, StoreKit tips. When connected to an account the app keeps the whole library available offline and syncs changes later.

THIRD-PARTY CONTENT
Book metadata and cover images come from the German National Library (DNB) and Open Library catalogues, fetched for the book the user adds.

ENCRYPTION
Only standard HTTPS/TLS provided by the OS; ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/sgitaize/bookshelv
